paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 3.16 as of 2026-10-16, with a change of -6.92% from the prior close and -36.16% over a window of 22 sessions. There have been 8 new news items in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include reports of insider selling, a major product recall, and regulatory probes, which have contributed to the stock's decline. Other news items mention a $6.5B TensorWave deal and the amendment of terms of an equipment supply loan from MUFG Bank. The Nuclear Regulatory Commission has also issued a draft environmental impact statement for Fermi America's Matador units.

There have been 25 total filings, including 3 Form 4 and 2 Form 144 filings. Recent filings include an 8-K form announcing a Limited Waiver and Amendment No. 1 to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, and Form 4 and 144 filings related to insider transactions.
